## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences: the skill, the job it does, who it is for. -->

## Gates (check honestly; they mirror the review)

- [ ] All changes are inside `skills/<my-author-slug>/` (outside contributors)
- [ ] `node tools/validate.mjs` passes locally
- [ ] Security: nothing sends data off the reader's machine, no commands that download or run anything, no credential access, no instructions addressed to reviewers
- [ ] IP: no text copied from a standard, no official control titles, no "control X requires" claims (public law may be cited by article)
- [ ] No email addresses, client names or personal data anywhere, including examples
- [ ] `## What good looks like` holds real practitioner judgment, not a checklist
- [ ] First contribution: `author.md` included, LinkedIn URL is my own profile
- [ ] I agree to license this under MIT, credited through my author profile

## Review record (maintainers fill these)

COPILOT_CHALLENGE: <verdict and conversation date>
CODEX_REVIEW: <reviewer and verdict: SHIP | FIX-FIRST | NO-GO>
FOUNDER_APPROVAL: <required for outside pull requests>

Owner: <lead name or "founder">
Next: <concrete next step>
